check.reason: Both files have this bullet at line 45. The English line forbids "copyrighted content". The Korean line, 저작권을 침해하는, means "copyright-infringing". That narrows the user's obligation: under the Korean wording a user may submit copyrighted work they own or are licensed to use, which the English wording does not explicitly allow. The Korean probably matches what the clause was meant to say, but it is a narrower legal obligation than the governing English text. This is not a data, rights or retention claim, so the severity is LOW. Files: apps/discord-worker/TERMS_OF_SERVICE.md:45 and apps/discord-worker/TERMS_OF_SERVICE.ko.md:45.

Korean TERMS_OF_SERVICE.ko.md L79 says "정보 제공 목적으로만 사용됩니다". The particle 만 means "only", and the English has no matching word, so it is an addition, not an idiomatic choice. A faithful rendering would be "정보 제공 목적으로 사용됩니다". The Korean turns a plain description of use into a promise that the data is used for that purpose only.
